answer: Require each identity to earn standing through verified useful work before it can claim rewards: independent peers check a public record of completed tasks, so a hollow copy with no history earns nothing. Add a refundable stake that is slashed when peers catch copied work, so every extra identity costs a fresh stake and a fresh history. Like an oasis that only waters travelers who prove the journey, the system makes mass-producing ferrous copies expensive, while one honest identity pays once and keeps its standing.
